name: Upscayl
tagline: Free and open-source AI image upscaler powered by advanced neural models
description: Upscayl allows you to upscale low-resolution images and photos up to 16x without losing quality or introducing blur, using cutting-edge deep learning super-resolution AI algorithms running completely locally.
features: Upscale images 4x, 8x, and 16x with sharp detail retention
Multiple neural models: Real-ESRGAN, Remacri, Ultramix, Digital Art
Batch upscaling for entire folders of photos
Runs 100% offline using Vulkan GPU compute
requirements: Linux x86_64, Vulkan-compatible GPU with 2GB+ VRAM
